$schemaComment: Ogma default static host. Secrets not required for Pages. Assert/apply scripts still Rank 7 queued.
name: ogma-static
basePathNotes: Project site: BASE_PATH=/<repo>/ at build. User site repo (user.github.io): BASE_PATH=/. Workflow sets BASE_PATH from github.event.repository.name.

dns.notes: Optional custom domain later via GitHub Pages settings; keep capability URLs on HTTPS origin + hash.

edge.notes: GitHub Pages CDN; not an Ogma media plane.

decision: Default to GitHub Pages unless a custom domain or preview-per-PR workflow forces another static host.
